```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Basic 3D Cone

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_cone(x = 1, y = 1, z = 1, u = 1, v = 1, w = 0) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      camera = go_scene_camera(
        eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = -0.76, y = 1.8, z = 0.92)
      )
    )
  )

fig
```

### Mulitple 3D Cones

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_cone(
    x = c(1, 2, 3),
    y = c(1, 2, 3),
    z = c(1, 2, 3),
    u = c(1, 0, 0),
    v = c(0, 3, 0),
    w = c(0, 0, 2),
    sizemode = "absolute",
    sizeref = 2,
    anchor = "tip",
    colorbar = go_colorbar(x = 0, xanchor = "right")
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      domain = go_domain(x = c(0, 1)),
      camera = go_scene_camera(
        eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = -1.57, y = 1.36, z = 0.58)
      )
    )
  )

fig
```

### 3D Cone Lighting

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

# every cone shares these properties; each trace differs by x and one setting
add_lit_cone <- function(fig, ...) {
  fig |>
    add_cone(
      y = c(1, 2, 3),
      z = c(1, 1, 1),
      u = c(1, 2, 3),
      v = c(1, 1, 2),
      w = c(4, 4, 1),
      showscale = FALSE,
      hoverinfo = "u+v+w+name",
      ...
    )
}

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "base",
    x = c(1, 1, 1)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "opacity=0.3",
    x = c(2, 2, 2),
    opacity = 0.3
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.ambient=0.3",
    x = c(3, 3, 3),
    lighting = go_cone_lighting(ambient = 0.3)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.diffuse=0.3",
    x = c(4, 4, 4),
    lighting = go_cone_lighting(diffuse = 0.3)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.specular=2",
    x = c(5, 5, 5),
    lighting = go_cone_lighting(specular = 2)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.roughness=1",
    x = c(6, 6, 6),
    lighting = go_cone_lighting(roughness = 1)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.fresnel=2",
    x = c(7, 7, 7),
    lighting = go_cone_lighting(fresnel = 2)
  ) |>
  add_lit_cone(
    name = "lighting.position x=0,y=0,z=1e5",
    x = c(8, 8, 8),
    lightposition = go_lightposition(x = 0, y = 0, z = 1e5)
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      aspectmode = "data",
      camera = go_scene_camera(
        eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 0.05, y = -2.6, z = 2)
      )
    ),
    margin = go_margin(t = 0, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  )

fig
```

### 3D Cone of Wind Dataset

```{r}
library(plotly.core)
library(jsonlite)

dat <- fromJSON(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/plotly.js/master/test/image/mocks/gl3d_cone-wind.json",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)
wind <- dat$data[[1]]

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_cone(
    x = unlist(wind$x),
    y = unlist(wind$y),
    z = unlist(wind$z),
    u = unlist(wind$u),
    v = unlist(wind$v),
    w = unlist(wind$w),
    text = "-> wind <-",
    hoverinfo = "u+v+w+text",
    colorscale = "Viridis",
    cmin = 0,
    cmax = 100
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      aspectratio = go_scene_aspectratio(x = 1.57, y = 1.36, z = 0.58)
    )
  )

fig
```

### 3D Cone Vortex

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/vortex.csv")

fig <- df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_cone(
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z,
    u = ~u,
    v = ~v,
    w = ~w,
    sizemode = "absolute",
    sizeref = 40
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      aspectratio = go_scene_aspectratio(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0.8),
      camera = go_scene_camera(
        eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 1.2, y = 1.2, z = 0.6)
      )
    )
  )

fig
```

See `go_cone()` for more information and chart attribute options!
